refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `SilikoDataSourceGet` function gets the current character from a `SilikoDataSource` object by calling the get function of the object. `Source` is the input source to advance. `Source` must be a value returned by `SiolikoDataSourceNew`.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: `SilikoDataSourceGet` returns return value of the call to the get function of the `SilikoDataSource` object (the current character if the object has characters to read, or `\0` if the source is exhausted).
